subject: Trial mode selection — ops plan, timelines & stakeholders
messages:
From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Finnley Cox <finnley@orbitai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Trial mode selection — hosted / dedicated / private (recap + ask)

Hi Finnley,

Thanks again for the call this morning — helpful to hear how OrbitAI expects to scale realtime summary generation across EU regions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the PoC path and the deployment mode decision.

Recap (from our notes):
- Primary constraint: EU data residency + SOC 2 Type II evidence for audit.
- Traffic profile: sustained 150-200 r/s at peak for short bursts; 1.2k tokens average response.
- Cost sensitivity: need predictable unit economics for forecasting.
- Integration: we will need VPC peering or private-link style connectivity to your VPC if we go private.

Deployment mode options (quick):
1) Hosted API — fastest onboarding, lower operational lift, but may not satisfy strict residency/SOC2 controls unless we enable Private Control Plane + region restrictions.
2) Dedicated capacity — reserved GPU pools in EU (SLA-backed), gives predictable throughput and isolation; easier for your compliance team than hosted, but requires a commitment.
3) Private (VPC/on-prem) — highest isolation and control (VPC peering or on-prem), supports HSM/KMS integration and full audit logs; longer lead time and ops coordination.

Ask: can you confirm which mode OrbitAI prefers to test in the initial PoC? If you prefer "Dedicated" or "Private," please confirm the stakeholders we should loop in from security/infra and a target timeline for kickoff. If you prefer Hosted for speed, we can sketch a shortened PoC focused on latency and cost and show how governance can be tightened.

Proposed PoC outline (attachment: trial_scope_v1.pdf):
- Duration: 4 weeks (pilot) + 2-week buffer for infra work if Private required.
- Success criteria: 99th percentile latency < 250ms server-side for 1k token responses; <10% quality regression vs baseline prompts (per your eval set); steady throughput at targeted r/s for 8h load window.
- Owner at Redwood: aditya_rao (pre-sales eng), support: marissa_cole (CS lead).
- Owner at OrbitAI: (please confirm).

If you can reply with preferred mode and available stakeholders, I’ll convert this into a formal mutual action plan and share an updated timeline + kickoff invite.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: trial_scope_v1.pdf (3 pages)
From: Finnley Cox <finnley@orbitai.com>

Cc: Raquel Mendes <raquel.m@orbitai.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 13:44:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Trial mode selection — ops plan, timelines & stakeholders

Thanks Aditya — good summary.

Short answer: OrbitAI wants to run the initial PoC on Dedicated capacity in the EU. Major drivers: predictable performance for the realtime path and easier path to satisfy our SOC2 auditor.

Stakeholders to include:
- Raquel Mendes (Head of Infrastructure) — will own peering/network questions.
- Tomas Jovanovic (Security Lead) — will want the SOC2 checklist and KMS/HSM details.
- Myself (Product) — will own the success criteria side.

Constraints / timeline:
- We can commit to a 6-week calendar window for the pilot (4-week test + 2-week buffer) starting as early as 2026-12-13, pending procurement approval.
- Procurement needs an initial MSA draft and order form.

Two quick asks:
1) Can you confirm the Dedicated sizing guidance (GPUs and expected throughput) for the profile I described?
2) Please attach the SOC2 evidence pack or link to the security Q&A we can share with Tomas.

Onwards —
Finnley
Product Lead | OrbitAI
finnley@orbitai.com

Hi Finnley / Raquel / Tomas —

Great, thanks for the confirmation. I’ve sketched a Dedicated-focused PoC plan below and attached the security Q&A workbook (security_q_and_a.xlsx).

Dedicated PoC plan (summary):
- Kickoff: week of 2026-12-13 (TBD specific day)
- Provisioning: allocate a 4 x A40-equivalent GPU pool in EU region; initial concurrency target: 200 concurrent workers, autoscale + burst to 300 for 30m windows.
- Tests:
  * Latency sweep across 1k/2k token sizes (p95/p99 targets).
  * Throughput soak (8-hour window at 150-200 r/s).
  * Functional evals: quality regression measured on your 150-case eval set.
  * Failover: route tests to fallback model variant to validate graceful degradation.
- Success gating: all p99 latency and quality targets met in same week under sustained load; documented runbook for autoscaling rules and rollback.
- Deliverables: final report with per-route token cost breakdown, per-token latency heatmaps, and deployment config used for reproducibility.

Procurement & admin items I’ll start:
- Share draft MSA + order form (ETA 48 hours).
- Share Dedicated sizing note with cost/commitment tiers.
- Share SOC2 evidence package + our security_q_and_a.xlsx (attached).

Logistics / action items for OrbitAI:
- Tomas: please confirm any additional encryption/KMS requirements and whether HSM is mandatory for the PoC.
- Raquel: confirm a single VPC CIDR for peering and any firewall rules we should anticipate.
- Finnley: confirm final kickoff date (preferred week is 2026-12-13).

I’ll also create a HubSpot MA Plan and send a calendar invite once kickoff day is locked. Sharing links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ORBIT-2026-0442 and a doc for the trial runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/drive/trial-templates/ORBIT-kickoff

Cheers —
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks — this looks good.

Tomas: HSM is not required for the initial PoC; KMS integration with customer-managed keys is fine. I’ll confirm the CIDR with Raquel and share a kickoff day by EOD tomorrow.

Marissa: I appreciate the heads-up on cost breakdown deliverables — any chance we can get an example Dedicated order form you’ve used for other EU customers?

I’ll wait for the MSA draft and the HubSpot MA Plan. Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Finnley
